IDQ20795
Australian Government Bureau of Meteorology

Initial Flood Warning for the Maroochy River, Coochin Creek and Mooloolah River

Issued at 2:01 pm AEST on Thursday 22 October 2026
Flood Warning Number: 1


Moderate to heavy rainfall has been observed along the Maroochy River, Coochin Creek and
Mooloolah River catchments since Wednesday. River level rises and areas of flooding are
occurring.

Further rises are possible with forecast rainfall.

Maroochy River:
Minor flooding is occurring along the Maroochy River.

Mooloolah River:
Minor flooding is occurring along the Mooloolah River.

Coochin Creek:
Minor to moderate flooding is occurring along Coochin Creek.

Safety Advice:
* Don't drive, walk, swim or play in floodwater because it is dangerous.
* Stay away from flooded drains, rivers, streams and waterways.
* Obey road closure signs. Plan ahead so you don't drive on flooded roads.
* Check the ABC and local media for updates. The situation can change quickly, so stay
informed.
* For local emergency management warnings and advice visit
www.disaster.qld.gov.au/warnings.

For emergency assistance call SES on telephone number 132 500. In life-threatening
emergencies, call 000 (triple zero) immediately.

Next issue:
The next warning will be issued by 02:00 PM AEST on Friday 23 October 2026.
